## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue when one exists.

## Validation

List completed checks and their results. Name affected platform or runtime checks
you could not run and the reason. For a rendering change, include a reproducible
scenario and visual evidence.

- [ ] Added a deterministic regression for changed behavior, or explained why it does not apply.
- [ ] Checked image ownership, cancellation and completion handling when affected.
- [ ] Updated usage or runtime documentation when the contract changes.
